description: Removed info.summary, an OpenAPI 3.1 field not allowed in this OpenAPI 3.0.2 document; its exact text was: "The Analytics API gives you access to metrics related to your Algolia search experience". Removed 6 invalid default: null values from non-null oneOf alternatives (the property's separate null alternative still allows null; no replacement default inferred). Represented 7 null-only oneOf alternatives as {type: string, nullable: true, enum: [null]} (accepts only null), keeping every other alternative and oneOf exclusivity. No other content changed.
